request: Create Technicians (name and hourly rate) and Time entries (description, work date and hours), where each time entry is linked to a technician.

outcome.renderedDiff:
New record type "Technician" with 2 fields:
  - Name (text, required)
  - Hourly rate (whole number)
  Records are shared by all companies in this tenant.
  It gets its own menu entry "Technician" with a list, a record page and a form.
  People who can use the rest of the application can create, change, archive and restore Technician records.
New record type "Time entry" with 3 fields:
  - Description (text, required)
  - Work date (date)
  - Hours (whole number)
  Records are shared by all companies in this tenant.
  It gets its own menu entry "Time entry" with a list, a record page and a form.
  People who can use the rest of the application can create, change, archive and restore Time entry records.
New required link "Technician" from Time entry to Technician. Choose it when creating a record.

Stored data: 2 new tables, 3 new indexes, addForeignKey. Nothing already stored is changed or removed.
Rolling back hides this change again and keeps every record entered under it.
